data.body: **P2 — Distinguish SerDes behavior by failure phase.** A permanent state-deserialization failure terminates `wait_for_condition`, but `RetryableSerDesError` is rethrown without a FAIL checkpoint. Also, a retryable error while reading an already-SUCCEEDED checkpoint occurs after the success checkpoint exists, so the next invocation retries deserialization without rerunning the step body or applying interrupted-step retry handling. Scope the documented body-replay behavior to first-run result round trips that fail before SUCCEED, and describe checkpoint-read retries separately.
